title: flow_external_worker_job_acquire input
description: Input for acquiring (locking) external worker jobs of a single topic. The engine locks up to numberOfTasks jobs for the given workerId; only that worker may then complete, fail or raise a BPMN error on them.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: The external-worker topic to pull work from (flowable:topic on the service task). Jobs are acquired per topic — one call, one topic.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker taking the lock. Must be repeated on the follow-up complete/fail/bpmnError/unacquire call.

lockDuration.title: Lock duration
lockDuration.description: How long the lock is held, as an ISO-8601 duration (e.g. PT10M). Once it expires the engine hands the job to the next worker, so it must comfortably exceed the expected processing time.

numberOfTasks.title: Number of tasks
numberOfTasks.description: Maximum number of jobs to lock in this call (batch size).

numberOfRetries.title: Number of retries
numberOfRetries.description: Retries the acquired jobs are given. Once they are used up the engine dead-letters the job instead of re-scheduling it.

scopeType.title: Scope type
scopeType.description: Restrict acquisition to jobs of one engine (BPMN processes or CMMN cases). Omit to acquire regardless of scope.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID).
